items.title: Kernel is pure Kotlin with zero Android imports (Kotlin Multiplatform-ready)
Strict layering: kernel → platform adapters → UI → libraries → app; lower layers never import higher ones
Single-activity architecture with a framework-owned root composable (AxfRoot)
Compose-first UI with an explicit AndroidView interop seam (no XML layouts in the framework)
One state model: immutable state + reducers + serializable snapshots (process-death restore)
Concurrency contract: structured coroutines, injected dispatchers, main-safe APIs, cancellation rules
One Result/Failure type used by every kernel and library API
One serializer (kotlinx.serialization) with unknown-field tolerance everywhere
Clock, ID generator, random and locale injected (never called statically)
DI container boundary: framework-owned graph, Hilt-compatible, every module declares its bindings
Min SDK / target SDK / Kotlin / Compose BOM versions pinned in a version catalog
Global ID + namespace scheme (ai.amberx.<port>.<module>.<thing>) for modules, assets, actions, permissions, routes, settings, events
Kernel API version + semver for every module; capability negotiation at load
Explicit public vs internal API (explicit API mode, @AxfInternal annotation, binary-compat validator)
Asset envelope versioning path: asset@1 now, asset@2 migration hooks declared, unknown types tolerated
Migration registry (assets, settings, databases, manifest) with ordered, idempotent steps
Deprecation policy and shims (nothing is ever removed without a shim + migration)
Manifest + lock conformance rules extended for Android (baked file hashes, module list, targets)
Feature flags + kill switches wired into the kernel from day one
AxfModule contract: id, version, deps, provides/requires capabilities, lifecycle (register → init → start → stop)
Extension point registry with typed slots (menus, routes, settings pages, actions, asset types, theme sources, log sinks, auth providers, billing providers…)
Typed placeholder/stub mechanism: every declared capability has a NotImplemented adapter that fails gracefully
Dynamic feature module support decided up front (base-module manifest + split install seam)
Deterministic module init order from the dependency graph + cycle detection
Asset type registry is open: new asset types can be registered by modules without a kernel change
Typed event bus with ordering + replay semantics defined now
Port registry placeholders: react/next, angular, python, desktop, iOS, wear, tv, auto, web-component
Typed action descriptors: description + JSON Schema input/output, effect, idempotent, long-running, streams (auto-generates MCP tools)
